cases.seededIssue: A critical persistence failure is caught and converted into apparent success.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Trace the exception path to the successful return.

cases.seededIssue: Two domain modules import each other and expose partially initialized state.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Show both dependency edges and the runtime initialization consequence.

cases.seededIssue: User-controlled keys accumulate in a process-global cache without a capacity boundary.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Establish the key source, lifetime, and absence of eviction.

cases.seededIssue: A per-order lookup repeats I/O that the data source can batch.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Trace one external read per order and name the scale assumption.

cases.seededIssue: Two pricing implementations share a concept but now apply different rounding and fee rules.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Compare behavior and identify the intended authority before merging.

cases.seededIssue: Tests cover a formatter while the persisted transfer path has no regression protection.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Map tests to the stated critical path rather than counting test files.

cases.seededIssue: The parser file is substantially longer than neighboring modules but implements one token-stream state machine with focused behavioral tests.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Evaluate responsibility and change cost, not line count alone.

cases.seededIssue: Two similar calculations intentionally implement retail and wholesale contracts.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Compare business invariants before treating syntax similarity as duplication.

cases.seededIssue: A legacy decoder remains required for persisted version-1 records.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Trace the persisted compatibility contract and migration boundary.

cases.seededIssue: A small self-contained CLI uses one module and has no scaling need for services.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Use project scale and deployment goals rather than architecture fashion.

cases.seededIssue: A visible loop looks expensive but committed benchmark evidence is inside budget.
cases.evidenceRequirement: Use the comparable benchmark and do not infer regression from syntax.

cases.seededIssue: A local single-user tool intentionally has no multi-tenant RBAC or admin service.
